Text[0]: **Beastmasters** fight alongside their familiars. To gain familiars, you must **befriend beasts** by using the action **Capture**. Using this action upon a weakened target may increase its success rate. Furthermore, the action **Gauge** will assess your chances of befriending a targeted beast.
Befriended beasts will be added to the **Master's Bestiary**, which may be accessed from the **main menu** via **Character**.

To summon familiars, you must first assign them to a **battlehorn**. You may do this via the subcommand when viewing the **Master's Bestiary**. Please note that you cannot assign battlehorns during combat.

By performing the requisite **Battlehorn** action, the assigned familiar will fly to your side.
As your beastmaster level increases, familiars will become able to execute special **weaponskills** and **abilities**. Strategically use their unique skills to emerge from battle victorious.
Search for potential familiars in their **natural habitats**. Travel the world, befriend new allies, and cultivate the companionship essential to any beastmaster!
Befriended beasts will be added to the **Master's Bestiary**, which may be accessed from the **main menu** via **Character**.
